title: boechera inyoensis
intro: Boechera inyoensis, commonly known as Inyo Mountains rockcress, is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. This plant is used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Boechera inyoensis include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
